title: GitHub sign-in fixed for Enter
summary:
GitHub sign-in got a callback fix, MCP guidance reached the API docs, and proxy work keeps public URLs pointed at public hosts.

A callback mismatch that blocked GitHub sign-in on enter.pollinations.ai was fixed.

The MCP server README was added to the API docs and their llm.txt index. A smoke-test client now checks the server connection and, when configured, text, image URL, and account tools. The main README also recapped May 20’s Polly and rendering updates; that recap does not represent another product change today.

Proxy and deployment configuration was added for Enter, Gen, Media, and Portkey. Enter and Gen now construct redirects, links, and generated image URLs from public-facing hosts rather than upstream hostnames, with related authentication and client-IP handling updates.
